scope.checkpoint: E2/M1 Runnable Backend / UI Vertical Slice
behavior_change: Split adjacent Chinese and English sentences without requiring whitespace after sentence punctuation.
Preserve the existing source reference, complete-source span and source statement order.
Surface a visible question when same-day return/exchange and multi-day or multi-week use claims coexist.
Bind the conflict question to the affected source statement IDs.
Avoid treating a same-day return by itself as a duration conflict.
non_goals: No schema, OpenAPI, migration, RAG, route, export or governance-document change.
No W7900, ROCm, vLLM, Serving Reference S1 or performance claim.

quality_mapping.track_2_relevance: Improves the private M1 Agent's current-source grounding and hallucination control by keeping source statements distinct and converting contradictory duration evidence into an explicit user question.
quality_mapping.submission_impact: Provides reproducible local evidence for the E2 runnable vertical-slice review. It does not promote E2 or replace the pending W7900 evidence.

input.fixture_or_scenario_id: public E2 fixtures plus synthetic adjacent Chinese/English and Chinese duration-conflict regressions

hardware.gpu_note: W7900 execution was explicitly deferred for this work package.

commands.cmd: bash -n scripts/*.sh && python3 -m py_compile scripts/*.py && python3 -m unittest discover -s qa/tests -v && bash qa/gates/pr_gate.sh --mode contract
commands.result: 31/31 public QA tests and the repository contract gate passed.
Checked-in JSON Schema and OpenAPI remain current.

commands.cmd: npm run verify:contracts && npm run test && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build
commands.result: 15/15 contract provenance checks, 95/95 Vitest tests, typecheck, ESLint and production build passed.
17/17 Playwright cases passed against the real loopback FastAPI service.

failures: The first targeted run failed four adapted-fixture cases because ASCII exclamation in the HTML fixture comment opener was incorrectly treated as a sentence boundary.
recovery: ASCII exclamation/question boundaries were constrained to real sentence-follow contexts while full-width Chinese punctuation remains whitespace-independent; all targeted and complete checks then passed.
unverified: Independent quality-owner acceptance of E2 checkpoint 2.
Serving Reference S1 and E2 Evidence / Promotion checkpoint.
E2 promotion, merge and E3 real-state integration.

artifacts.description: Punctuation-aware segmentation, bilingual duration-conflict detection and source-statement question binding.
Adjacent Chinese/English, Chinese contradiction, provenance/order and non-conflict regressions.

known_risks: Duration conflict detection is deliberately bounded and heuristic; it surfaces a question rather than asserting which timeline is true.
W7900/local-model evidence remains pending and is not inferred from local fake or unavailable-model paths.
